hardCaps.publicInvariant: Committed bytes, Blob References, Release publication, range rejection and terminal effects remain atomic and conserved.
Unknown, concurrent and restart replay never creates a second business effect.
Committed transitions have one stable Event and rollback has none; retries preserve identity and semantic body.
Pending Work survives process death and stale lease owners cannot publish or collect content.
Migration preserves bytes, identities, ETags, events, saved replay, deadlines and old-client response bodies.

specGaps.summary: No new Manager Domain Event type name is published; the evaluator requires no invented type.
No Release collection endpoint is published; UI cases use detail and navigation without inventing one.
